import pandas as pd
sql_query = """
WITH assignments AS (
    SELECT 
        "[Employee Master[Employee Name]]",
        "[Employee Master[Email Address]]",
        MAX(rec['Employee Assignment History[Assignment Start Date]']) as max_assignment_date
    FROM enterprise_data, 
    UNNEST("[Employee Assignment History[Assignment Name][Position Title][Employee Grade][Assignment Start Date][Assignment End Date][Assignment Experience (Years & Months)]]") AS t(rec)
    GROUP BY "[Employee Master[Employee Name]]", "[Employee Master[Email Address]]"
),
assignment_titles AS (
    SELECT 
        e."[Employee Master[Employee Name]]",
        e."[Employee Master[Email Address]]",
        rec['Employee Assignment History[Position Title]'] as assignment_title,
        rec['Employee Assignment History[Assignment Start Date]'] as assign_start_date
    FROM enterprise_data e, 
    UNNEST("[Employee Assignment History[Assignment Name][Position Title][Employee Grade][Assignment Start Date][Assignment End Date][Assignment Experience (Years & Months)]]") AS t1(rec),
    assignments a
    WHERE rec['Employee Assignment History[Assignment Start Date]'] = a.max_assignment_date
      AND e."[Employee Master[Employee Name]]" = a."[Employee Master[Employee Name]]"
      AND e."[Employee Master[Email Address]]" = a."[Employee Master[Email Address]]"
),
leave_details AS (
    SELECT 
        "[Employee Master[Employee Name]]",
        "[Employee Master[Email Address]]",
        MAX(rec['Employee Leave Details[Leave Start Date]']) as max_leave_date
    FROM enterprise_data, 
    UNNEST("[Employee Leave Details[Leave Type][Leave Duration (Days)][Approval Status][Leave Start Date][Leave End Date]]") AS t(rec)
    GROUP BY "[Employee Master[Employee Name]]", "[Employee Master[Email Address]]"
),
recent_leave AS (
    SELECT 
        e."[Employee Master[Employee Name]]",
        e."[Employee Master[Email Address]]",
        rec['Employee Leave Details[Leave Type]'] as leave_type,
        rec['Employee Leave Details[Leave Start Date]'] as leave_start_date
    FROM enterprise_data e, 
    UNNEST("[Employee Leave Details[Leave Type][Leave Duration (Days)][Approval Status][Leave Start Date][Leave End Date]]") AS t2(rec),
    leave_details l
    WHERE rec['Employee Leave Details[Leave Start Date]'] = l.max_leave_date
      AND e."[Employee Master[Employee Name]]" = l."[Employee Master[Employee Name]]"
      AND e."[Employee Master[Email Address]]" = l."[Employee Master[Email Address]]"
),
competencies AS (
    SELECT 
        "[Employee Master[Employee Name]]",
        "[Employee Master[Email Address]]",
        MAX(rec['Employee Competencies Rating[Employee Rating]']) as max_rating
    FROM enterprise_data, 
    UNNEST("[Employee Competencies Rating[Competancy Name][Employee Rating][Supervisor Rating][Employee Rating Description][Supervisor Rating Description]]") AS t(rec)
    GROUP BY "[Employee Master[Employee Name]]", "[Employee Master[Email Address]]"
),
highest_rating AS (
    SELECT 
        e."[Employee Master[Employee Name]]",
        e."[Employee Master[Email Address]]",
        rec['Employee Competencies Rating[Competancy Name]'] as competency_name,
        rec['Employee Competencies Rating[Employee Rating]'] as employee_rating
    FROM enterprise_data e, 
    UNNEST("[Employee Competencies Rating[Competancy Name][Employee Rating][Supervisor Rating][Employee Rating Description][Supervisor Rating Description]]") AS t3(rec),
    competencies c
    WHERE rec['Employee Competencies Rating[Employee Rating]'] = c.max_rating
      AND e."[Employee Master[Employee Name]]" = c."[Employee Master[Employee Name]]"
      AND e."[Employee Master[Email Address]]" = c."[Employee Master[Email Address]]"
)
SELECT 
    e."[Employee Master[Employee Name]]" as employee_name,
    e."[Employee Master[Email Address]]" as email_address,
    (SELECT assignment_title FROM assignment_titles a WHERE a."[Employee Master[Employee Name]]" = e."[Employee Master[Employee Name]]" AND a."[Employee Master[Email Address]]" = e."[Employee Master[Email Address]]" LIMIT 1) as most_recent_assignment_title,
